description: Find the Chinese zodiac animal and element for a birth year, as Anahana's free Chinese Zodiac Calculator does (by Gregorian year, from 1924). Returns the animal, element, traits (English), the method and the calculator page in the language asked for. The Chinese year starts at Lunar New Year, so for a birthday in January or early February the response's method explains when the previous year's animal applies. Read-only; the year is not stored.

language.description: Language for the linked pages, e.g. "de". One code; defaults to "en".

name: get_chinese_zodiac
title: Find a Chinese zodiac animal and element
